Package org.geysermc.paletter.annotation

Annotation Interface ServerOnly

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(TYPE) public @interface ServerOnly
Marks a component that Bedrock Dedicated Server accepts in a pack but never sends to clients, in the protocols of the range. Palettes of those protocols leave the component out and add a WARNING to Palette#report(); where Bedrock sends it again, the same record is encoded as usual. The range comes from the captures of BDS (the status of the component's protocol windows in data/model/mappings.json), not from a list.

Without since() and until() the component is server only in every protocol.

Since:
1.0.0
